# Checklist for the Model Deployment Project

<!-- If you are done with a topic mark the checkboxes with an `x` (like `[x]`) -->

- [ ] I read and understood the tasks.
- [ ] I loaded and prepared the January 2025 Yellow Taxi data.
- [ ] I trained a model and tracked the experiment in MLflow.
- [ ] I wrote an API with a `/predict` endpoint.
- [ ] I ran the API locally or in Docker.
- [ ] I made a request against the API.
- [ ] I documented the RMSE and my follow-up ideas in the README.

Bonus:

- [ ] I tested the model and the API.
- [ ] I used grid search or Optuna for hyperparameter tuning.
